name: Tubular Lock Picking
description: Tubular locks have pins arranged in a circular pattern around the key's axis and are found on vending machines, bike locks, display cases, and some alarm panels. Tubular pick tools simultaneously tension all pins and allow the operator to set each one by feel. Many tubular locks are low-security and open quickly with the right tool. A tubular lockpick is a niche but essential addition to any red team kit for targets with display cases, server cage locks, or vending equipment.

blue.det: Specialized tool visible at tubular keyway; time at target lock.
blue.cm: Upgrade vending machines and alarm panels to electronic access; high-security tubular cylinders; physical access control to areas containing tubular-locked equipment.
